subject: QBR: Prioritizing backfills and exception req approvals
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: QBR: Prioritizing backfills and exception req approvals

Team —

Ahead of next week's QBR I pulled together a short impact deck and the raw numbers (attached). We have five open reqs where the hiring manager has asked for an exception to the current hiring pause because the headcount directly maps to Q3 OKRs (reliability & latency, dedicated capacity onboarding, and two customer-facing infra roles). Summary here: 

- REQ-4128 (Infra SRE, Backfill) — Critical: On-path for dedicated capacity SLA metrics.
- REQ-4134 (Model Serving Engineer) — High priority: needed to finish the model optimization epic.
- REQ-4140 (Solutions PM) — Medium: customer enablement for a strategic partner.
- REQ-4152 (Data Infra Engineer) — Low: backlog cleanup, not directly on Q3 OKRs.
- REQ-4161 (Customer Success Manager) — Medium: churn risk for a named account if not filled.

Ask: please review the attached workbook and reply with approvals or objections by EOD Monday (9/13). For any approvals, indicate whether we should route as an "exception" (exec sign-off + expedite) or "standard backfill." If no reply, I'll assume the role remains frozen.

Why this matters for QBR: our QBR narrative is focused on delivering latency and reliability wins while keeping unit costs within the Optimize recommendations. If we let the SRE and Serving roles remain frozen, we'll likely miss two latency SLO improvements planned for Q3 (affects OKR 1.2 and 1.3).

Attachments: QBR_headcount_impact.xlsx (spreadsheet with per-role OKR mapping), backfill-priority-board.png

Thanks —
Jonas
Jonas Weber
VP, Infrastructure & Serving
Redwood Inference

Jonas —

Thanks for the packet. Quick clarifying Qs before I sign off: 

- Can you rank the five reqs by impact-to-OKR (1 highest — 5 lowest)?
- Who will be the hiring owner for each approved exception (we need a named owner for People Ops SLA)?

If you push the Data Infra (REQ-4152) to frozen, want to confirm we have a mitigation plan for technical debt backlog.

Date: Sun, 12 Sep 2026 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR: Prioritizing backfills and exception req approvals

Laura / Jonas —

Ranking & owners (proposed):
1) REQ-4128 Infra SRE (Jonas owner) — exception, expedite (2–3 week recruiter lead time + priority screening).
2) REQ-4134 Model Serving Engineer (Jonas owner) — exception, expedite (critical for model perf OKR).
3) REQ-4161 Customer Success Manager (Marissa owner) — standard backfill but prioritize for the named-account renewal.
4) REQ-4140 Solutions PM (Marissa owner) — hold unless partner signs LOI; low immediate OKR impact.
5) REQ-4152 Data Infra Engineer (Evelyn owner) — freeze for Q3; propose one temporary contractor for backlog triage if budget allows.

Budget note: if we mark two exceptions (4128 & 4134) we'll need a small one-time spend to cover bonus/offer stretch to close quickly. Recommend Vivek signs off on the incremental ask.

Aditya
Aditya Rao
Dir. Product Infrastructure

We can also attach a recruiter-facing one-pager to the req; let us know if you'd like Brightwork (our vendor) to take a first pass.

Thanks all — final decisions below and next steps for QBR prep: 

Decisions (approved today):
- REQ-4128 Infra SRE — APPROVED (exception). Jonas to work with People Ops to enable priority outreach; target offer within 21 days.
- REQ-4134 Model Serving Engineer — APPROVED (exception). Jonas to coordinate with Brightwork for pipeline.
- REQ-4161 CSM — APPROVED as standard backfill; Marissa to prioritize outreach for named account.
- REQ-4140 Solutions PM — HOLD until partner LOI; Marissa to revisit in 30 days.
- REQ-4152 Data Infra Engineer — FROZEN for Q3; Evelyn to scope contractor option if urgent backlog emerges.

Budget: Vivek, please confirm the incremental headcount spending for the two exceptions (one-time sign-on range & priority hiring budget).

QBR asks: Evelyn/Marissa please update the headcount slides to reflect exceptions and the expected time-to-offer. Laura — please cross-check that People Ops has the approved owners on the reqs so we meet SLA. I'll include a one-slide headcount decision summary in the QBR narrative.

Thanks —
